- Use clarify_request ONLY for major business goal ambiguity or destructive data intent.
- After stage_plugin_changes, you MUST call verify_candidate and get ok=true before calling present_preview.

```ts
interface SlotContribution {
  readonly name: string;
  readonly component: ComponentType<never>;
  readonly order: number;
}

type SlotRegistrar = (contribution: SlotContribution) => unknown;

function resolveSlotRegistrar(ctx: Context): SlotRegistrar | null {
  const host = ctx as unknown as {
    readonly slot?: { readonly register?: unknown };
    readonly slots?: { readonly register?: unknown };
    readonly router?: { readonly registerSlot?: unknown };
    readonly registerSlot?: unknown;
  };
  const candidates: Array<{ readonly owner: unknown; readonly fn: unknown }> = [
    { owner: host.slot, fn: host.slot?.register },
    { owner: host.slots, fn: host.slots?.register },
    { owner: host.router, fn: host.router?.registerSlot },
    { owner: host, fn: host.registerSlot },
  ];
  for (const candidate of candidates) {
    if (typeof candidate.fn === "function") {
      return (contribution) => (candidate.fn as (this: unknown, arg: unknown) => unknown).call(candidate.owner, contribution);
    }
  }
  return null;
```
```ts
}
```

```ts
type SlotContribution = {
  readonly name: string;
  readonly component: ComponentType<never>;
  readonly order: number;

type SlotRegistrarContext = {
  readonly slot?: { readonly register?: unknown };
  readonly slots?: { readonly register?: unknown };
  readonly router?: { readonly registerSlot?: unknown };
  readonly registerSlot?: unknown;
};

/**
 * Resolve the host client entry point that mounts a component into a named slot.
 * The host exposes slot mounting on the client context; probe the small set of
 * documented shapes so the plugin keeps working across host SDK revisions.
 */
function mountInSlot(ctx: Context, contribution: SlotContribution): void {
  const host = ctx as unknown as SlotRegistrarContext;
  const candidates: ReadonlyArray<{ readonly owner: unknown; readonly fn: unknown }> = [
    { owner: host.slot, fn: host.slot?.register },
    { owner: host.slots, fn: host.slots?.register },
    { owner: host.router, fn: host.router?.registerSlot },
    { owner: host, fn: host.registerSlot },
  ];
  const { name, component, order } = contribution;
  for (const { owner, fn } of candidates) {
    if (typeof fn !== "function") continue;
    const register = fn as (this: unknown, ...args: unknown[]) => unknown;
    try {
      register.call(owner, { name, component, order });
      return;
    } catch {
      // fall through to the positional signature below
    }
    try {
      register.call(owner, name, { component, order });
      return;
    } catch {
      // try the next candidate entry point
    }
  }
  console.warn(`[todo-tags] Could not mount a component into slot "${name}".`);
```
```ts
}
```

```ts
type SlotOptions = { readonly component: unknown; readonly order?: number };

interface SlotHostContext {
  readonly slot?: {
    readonly register?: (
      name: string,
      options: SlotOptions,
    ) => void;
  };
  readonly router?: {
    readonly registerSlot?: (
      name: string,
      options: SlotOptions,
    ) => void;
  };
}

function resolveRegistrar(ctx: Context): ((name: string, options: SlotOptions) => void) | null {
  const host = ctx as unknown as SlotHostContext;
  const slotRegister = host.slot?.register;
  if (typeof slotRegister === "function") {
    return (name, options) => slotRegister.call(host.slot, name, options);
  }
  const routerRegisterSlot = host.router?.registerSlot;
  if (typeof routerRegisterSlot === "function") {
    return (name, options) => routerRegisterSlot.call(host.router, name, options);
  }
  return null;
```
```tsx
}
```

```ts
interface SlotContribution {
  readonly name: string;
  readonly component: ComponentType<never>;
  readonly order: number;
}

type SlotRegistrar = (contribution: SlotContribution) => unknown;

function resolveSlotRegistrar(ctx: Context): SlotRegistrar | null {
  const host = ctx as unknown as {
    readonly slot?: { readonly register?: unknown };
    readonly slots?: { readonly register?: unknown };
    readonly router?: { readonly registerSlot?: unknown };
    readonly registerSlot?: unknown;
  };
  const candidates: Array<{ readonly owner: unknown; readonly fn: unknown }> = [
    { owner: host.slot, fn: host.slot?.register },
    { owner: host.slots, fn: host.slots?.register },
    { owner: host.router, fn: host.router?.registerSlot },
    { owner: host, fn: host.registerSlot },
  ];
  for (const candidate of candidates) {
    if (typeof candidate.fn === "function") {
      return (contribution) => (candidate.fn as (this: unknown, arg: unknown) => unknown).call(candidate.owner, contribution);
    }
  }
  return null;
```
```ts
}
```

```ts
type SlotContribution = {
  readonly name: string;
  readonly component: ComponentType<never>;
  readonly order: number;
};

type SlotRegistrarContext = {
  readonly slot?: { readonly register?: unknown };
  readonly slots?: { readonly register?: unknown };
  readonly router?: { readonly registerSlot?: unknown };
  readonly registerSlot?: unknown;
};

/**
 * Resolve the host client entry point that mounts a component into a named slot.
 * The host exposes slot mounting on the client context; probe the small set of
 * documented shapes so the plugin keeps working across host SDK revisions.
 */
function mountInSlot(ctx: Context, contribution: SlotContribution): void {
  const host = ctx as unknown as SlotRegistrarContext;
  const candidates: ReadonlyArray<{ readonly owner: unknown; readonly fn: unknown }> = [
    { owner: host.slot, fn: host.slot?.register },
    { owner: host.slots, fn: host.slots?.register },
    { owner: host.router, fn: host.router?.registerSlot },
    { owner: host, fn: host.registerSlot },
  ];
  const { name, component, order } = contribution;
  for (const { owner, fn } of candidates) {
    if (typeof fn !== "function") continue;
    const register = fn as (this: unknown, ...args: unknown[]) => unknown;
    try {
      register.call(owner, { name, component, order });
      return;
    } catch {
      // fall through to the positional signature below
    }
    try {
      register.call(owner, name, { component, order });
      return;
    } catch {
      // try the next candidate entry point
    }
  }
  console.warn(`[todo-tags] Could not mount a component into slot "${name}".`);
```
```tsx
}
```

```ts
interface SlotContribution {
  readonly name: string;
  readonly component: ComponentType<never>;
  readonly order: number;
}

type SlotRegistrar = (contribution: SlotContribution) => unknown;

function resolveSlotRegistrar(ctx: Context): SlotRegistrar | null {
  const host = ctx as unknown as {
    readonly slot?: { readonly register?: unknown };
    readonly slots?: { readonly register?: unknown };
    readonly router?: { readonly registerSlot?: unknown };
    readonly registerSlot?: unknown;
  };
  const candidates: Array<{ readonly owner: unknown; readonly fn: unknown }> = [
    { owner: host.slot, fn: host.slot?.register },
    { owner: host.slots, fn: host.slots?.register },
    { owner: host.router, fn: host.router?.registerSlot },
    { owner: host, fn: host.registerSlot },
  ];
  for (const candidate of candidates) {
    if (typeof candidate.fn === "function") {
      return (contribution) => (candidate.fn as (this: unknown, arg: unknown) => unknown).call(candidate.owner, contribution);
    }
  }
  return null;
```
```ts
}
```

```ts
type SlotContribution = {
  readonly name: string;
  readonly component: ComponentType<never>;
  readonly order: number;
};

type SlotRegistrarContext = {
  readonly slot?: { readonly register?: unknown };
  readonly slots?: { readonly register?: unknown };
  readonly router?: { readonly registerSlot?: unknown };
  readonly registerSlot?: unknown;
};

/**
 * Resolve the host client entry point that mounts a component into a named slot.
 * The host exposes slot mounting on the client context; probe the small set of
 * documented shapes so the plugin keeps working across host SDK revisions.
 */
function mountInSlot(ctx: Context, contribution: SlotContribution): void {
  const host = ctx as unknown as SlotRegistrarContext;
  const candidates: ReadonlyArray<{ readonly owner: unknown; readonly fn: unknown }> = [
    { owner: host.slot, fn: host.slot?.register },
    { owner: host.slots, fn: host.slots?.register },
    { owner: host.router, fn: host.router?.registerSlot },
    { owner: host, fn: host.registerSlot },
  ];
  const { name, component, order } = contribution;
  for (const { owner, fn } of candidates) {
    if (typeof fn !== "function") continue;
    const register = fn as (this: unknown, ...args: unknown[]) => unknown;
    try {
      register.call(owner, { name, component, order });
      return;
    } catch {
      // fall through to the positional signature below
    }
    try {
      register.call(owner, name, { component, order });
      return;
    } catch {
      // try the next candidate entry point
    }
  }
  console.warn(`[todo-tags] Could not mount a component into slot "${name}".`);
```
```ts
}
```

```ts
type SlotOptions = { readonly component: unknown; readonly order?: number };

interface SlotHostContext {
  readonly slot?: {
    readonly register?: (
      name: string,
      options: SlotOptions,
    ) => void;
  };
  readonly router?: {
    readonly registerSlot?: (
      name: string,
      options: SlotOptions,
    ) => void;
  };
}

function resolveRegistrar(ctx: Context): ((name: string, options: SlotOptions) => void) | null {
  const host = ctx as unknown as SlotHostContext;
  const slotRegister = host.slot?.register;
  if (typeof slotRegister === "function") {
    return (name, options) => slotRegister.call(host.slot, name, options);
  }
  const routerRegisterSlot = host.router?.registerSlot;
  if (typeof routerRegisterSlot === "function") {
    return (name, options) => routerRegisterSlot.call(host.router, name, options);
```
```ts
  }
  return null;
```
```ts
}
```

```ts
type SlotContribution = {
  readonly name: string;
  readonly component: ComponentType<never>;
  readonly order: number;
};

type SlotRegistrarContext = {
  readonly slot?: { readonly register?: unknown };
  readonly slots?: { readonly register?: unknown };
  readonly router?: { readonly registerSlot?: unknown };
  readonly registerSlot?: unknown;
};

/**
 * Resolve the host client entry point that mounts a component into a named slot.
 * The host exposes slot mounting on the client context; probe the small set of
 * documented shapes so the plugin keeps working across host SDK revisions.
 */
function mountInSlot(ctx: Context, contribution: SlotContribution): void {
  const host = ctx as unknown as SlotRegistrarContext;
  const candidates: ReadonlyArray<{ readonly owner: unknown; readonly fn: unknown }> = [
    { owner: host.slot, fn: host.slot?.register },
    { owner: host.slots, fn: host.slots?.register },
    { owner: host.router, fn: host.router?.registerSlot },
    { owner: host, fn: host.registerSlot },
  ];
  const { name, component, order } = contribution;
  for (const { owner, fn } of candidates) {
    if (typeof fn !== "function") continue;
    const register = fn as (this: unknown, ...args: unknown[]) => unknown;
    try {
      register.call(owner, { name, component, order });
      return;
    } catch {
      // fall through to the positional signature below
    }
    try {
      register.call(owner, name, { component, order });
      return;
    } catch {
      // try the next candidate entry point
    }
  }
  console.warn(`[todo-tags] Could not mount a component into slot "${name}".`);
```
```ts
}
```

args.summary: 新增 todo-tags 插件：自带标签表与任务关联表，提供标签增删查 / 任务标签设置接口，并通过 todo-core 的插槽在任务行展示标签、在任务详情内编辑标签。已通过全部四个验证门（构建/DAG/热插拔、消融、子图红绿与克隆库冒烟、测试差异披露）。
highlights: 自有存储：plg_todo_tags__tags（名称唯一、颜色枚举、大小写不敏感去重）与 plg_todo_tags__task_tags（以 task_id 为不透明外键，无跨插件内部依赖）
HTTP 接口：GET/POST /api/app/todo-tags/tags、DELETE /tags/:id，GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /tasks/:taskId/tags（整体替换与单条挂载/解绑），校验齐全（400/404/409）
服务与事件：提供服务 tags（TagService：list/get/create/delete/listForTask/attach/detach/setForTask），并在变更时派发 tags:changed 事件
任务行展示：TaskTagBadges 注入 todo.item.badges，渲染彩色标签胶囊（行内样式取色，不依赖额外主题调色板）
标签编辑：TaskTagEditor 注入 todo.item.detail，标签点选即保存、支持内联新建并自动挂载；刻意不使用嵌套 <form>（该插槽嵌在详情表单内），改用 type="button" + Enter 键处理
跨组件同步：编辑后派发 window 事件 todo-tags:changed，任务行标签即时刷新
客户端注入：slot 属于 Cordis 客户端服务，已通过 export const inject = ['slot'] + ctx.inject(['slot'], …) 声明后再注册插槽
插件无硬依赖：仅向 todo-core 发布的插槽投影 UI，todo-core 单独消融时仍可正常工作

```ts
private findByName(name: string): Tag | null {
```
```ts
  const key = normalizeTagName(name);
  const row = this.db.prepare(`SELECT ... WHERE name_key = ?`).get<TagRow>(key);

  return legacy ? toTag(legacy) : null;
}
```

```ts
private save(input: string | CreateTagInput): SaveTagResult {
```
```ts
  const rawName = typeof input === "string" ? input : input.name;
  const name = normalizeTagName(rawName ?? "");

  if (!isTagColor(color)) {

  // untouched, so tags written before this normalization keep their original
  // casing and metadata and remain readable as-is.

  const id = globalThis.crypto.randomUUID();

  const tag = this.get(id)!;
  this.emitChanged(null, [id]);
  return { tag, created: true };
}

private findByName(name: string): Tag | null {

  const row = this.db
    .prepare(`SELECT ${TAG_COLUMNS} FROM plg_todo_tags__tags WHERE name_key = ?`)

    .all<TagRow>();
  const legacy = rows.find((candidate) => normalizeTagName(candidate.name) === key);
  return legacy ? toTag(legacy) : null;
}
```

```ts
private save(input: string | CreateTagInput): SaveTagResult {
```
```ts
  const rawName = typeof input === "string" ? input : input.name;
  const name = normalizeTagName(rawName ?? "");
  if (!name) {
    throw httpError(400, "Tag name is required");
  }
  if (name.length > MAX_TAG_NAME_LENGTH) {
    throw httpError(400, `Tag name must be at most ${MAX_TAG_NAME_LENGTH} characters`);
  }
  const color = typeof input === "string" ? DEFAULT_TAG_COLOR : (input.color ?? DEFAULT_TAG_COLOR);
  if (!isTagColor(color)) {
    throw httpError(400, `Invalid tag color: ${String(color)}`);
  }

  // Deduplicate on the canonical (lowercase) name. The existing tag is returned
  // untouched, so tags written before this normalization keep their original
  // casing and metadata and remain readable as-is.
  const existing = this.findByName(name);
  if (existing) {
    return { tag: existing, created: false };
  }

  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const id = globalThis.crypto.randomUUID();
  this.db
    .prepare(
      "INSERT INTO plg_todo_tags__tags (id, name, name_key, color, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
    )
    .run(id, name, name, color, now);

  const tag = this.get(id)!;
  this.emitChanged(null, [id]);
  return { tag, created: true };
}

  const rows = this.db

    .all<TagRow>();
  const legacy = rows.find((candidate) => normalizeTagName(candidate.name) === key);
```

```ts
  private beforeTransition(payload: TransitionPayload): string | void {
    if (!payload || payload.nextState !== "done") return;
    const taskId = payload.task?.id;
    if (typeof taskId !== "string" || taskId.length === 0) return;
    const summary = extractSummary(payload.meta);
    if (summary === null) return "完成任务前必须填写复盘总结";
    if (summary.length === 0) return "复盘总结不能为空";
    if (summary.length > MAX_SUMMARY_LENGTH) return `复盘总结最多 ${MAX_SUMMARY_LENGTH} 个字符`;
    this.record(taskId, typeof payload.task?.title === "string" ? payload.task.title : "", summary);

    const review = this.get(taskId);
    if (review) (this.ctx as unknown as EventBus).emit("review:recorded", review);
  }
}
```

```ts
import { Service, type Context } from "cordis";
import type { ScopedDb } from "@host/server-sdk";
import type { Review, ReviewService } from "./contract.d.ts";

const MAX_SUMMARY_LENGTH = 2000;
const REVIEW_COLUMNS = "task_id, task_title, summary, created_at, updated_at";

interface ReviewRow {
  readonly task_id: string;
  readonly task_title: string;
  readonly summary: string;
  readonly created_at: string;
  readonly updated_at: string;
}

interface TransitionPayload {
  readonly task?: { readonly id?: unknown; readonly title?: unknown };
  readonly nextState?: unknown;
  readonly meta?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

interface EventBus {
  on(event: string, listener: (payload: unknown) => unknown): unknown;
  emit(event: string, payload: unknown): unknown;
}

function toReview(row: ReviewRow): Review {
  return {
    taskId: row.task_id,
    taskTitle: row.task_title,
    summary: row.summary,
    createdAt: row.created_at,
    updatedAt: row.updated_at,
  };
}

/** Reads the generic `meta.review` extension: a plain string or `{ summary }`. */
function extractSummary(meta: Record<string, unknown> | undefined): string | null {
  if (!meta) return null;
  const raw = meta.review;
  if (typeof raw === "string") return raw.trim();
  if (raw && typeof raw === "object") {
    const summary = (raw as { readonly summary?: unknown }).summary;
    if (typeof summary === "string") return summary.trim();
  }
  return null;
}

export default class TodoReviewService extends Service implements ReviewService {
  private readonly db: ScopedDb;
  private readonly events: EventBus;

  constructor(ctx: Context) {
    super(ctx, "todoReview");
    this.db = ctx.db;
    this.events = ctx as unknown as EventBus;

    this.db.exec(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS plg_todo_review__reviews (
        task_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        task_title TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        summary TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      )
    `);

    ctx.http.route("GET", "/reviews", () => ({ reviews: this.list() }));
    ctx.http.route("GET", "/reviews/:taskId", (req) => ({
      review: this.get(req.params.taskId),
    }));

    // Generic todo-core seam: validate/record before the transition is applied.
    this.events.on("todo:before-transition", (payload) =>
      this.beforeTransition(payload as TransitionPayload),
    );
  }

  list(): Review[] {
    const rows = this.db
      .prepare(
        `SELECT ${REVIEW_COLUMNS} FROM plg_todo_review__reviews ORDER BY updated_at DESC, task_id ASC`,
      )
      .all<ReviewRow>();
    return rows.map(toReview);
  }

  get(taskId: string): Review | null {
    const row = this.db
      .prepare(
        `SELECT ${REVIEW_COLUMNS} FROM plg_todo_review__reviews WHERE task_id = ?`,
      )
      .get<ReviewRow>(taskId);
    return row ? toReview(row) : null;
  }

  private beforeTransition(payload: TransitionPayload): string | void {
    if (!payload || payload.nextState !== "done") return;
    const taskId = payload.task?.id;
    if (typeof taskId !== "string" || taskId.length === 0) return;

    const summary = extractSummary(payload.meta);
    if (summary === null) {
      return "完成任务前必须填写复盘总结";
    }
    if (summary.length === 0) {
      return "复盘总结不能为空";
    }
    if (summary.length > MAX_SUMMARY_LENGTH) {
      return `复盘总结最多 ${MAX_SUMMARY_LENGTH} 个字符`;
    }

    const title =
      typeof payload.task?.title === "string" ? payload.task.title : "";
    this.record(taskId, title, summary);
  }

  private record(taskId: string, taskTitle: string, summary: string): void {
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const existing = this.get(taskId);
    const title = taskTitle.length > 0 ? taskTitle : (existing?.taskTitle ?? "");
    this.db
      .prepare(
        `INSERT INTO plg_todo_review__reviews (task_id, task_title, summary, created_at, updated_at)
         VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
         ON CONFLICT(task_id) DO UPDATE SET
           task_title = excluded.task_title,
           summary = excluded.summary,
           updated_at = excluded.updated_at`,
      )
      .run(taskId, title, summary, existing?.createdAt ?? now, now);

    const review = this.get(taskId);
    if (review) this.events.emit("review:recorded", review);
  }
}
```

```ts
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import type { PluginTestContext } from "@host/server-sdk";

interface TaskPayload {
  readonly task: { readonly id: string; readonly state: string };
}

interface ReviewPayload {
  readonly review:
    | {
        readonly taskId: string;
        readonly summary: string;
        readonly createdAt: string;
        readonly updatedAt: string;
      }
    | null;
}

interface ReviewListPayload {
  readonly reviews: ReadonlyArray<{ readonly taskId: string; readonly summary: string }>;
}

export default async function (ctx: PluginTestContext): Promise<void> {
  const created = await ctx.request({
    method: "POST",
    path: "/api/app/todo-core/tasks",
    body: { title: "Review gated task" },
  });
  assert.equal(created.status, 201);
  const taskId = (created.body as TaskPayload).task.id;

  const transition = (body: Record<string, unknown>) =>
    ctx.request({
      method: "POST",
      path: `/api/app/todo-core/tasks/${taskId}/transition`,
      body,
    });

  // The server rejects completion without a review summary.
  const missing = await transition({ nextState: "done" });
  assert.equal(missing.status, 422);

  const blank = await transition({
    nextState: "done",
    meta: { review: { summary: "   " } },
  });
  assert.equal(blank.status, 422);

  const invalid = await transition({
    nextState: "done",
    meta: { review: 42 },
  });
  assert.equal(invalid.status, 422);

  const stillOpen = await ctx.request({
    method: "GET",
    path: `/api/app/todo-core/tasks/${taskId}`,
  });
  assert.equal((stillOpen.body as TaskPayload).task.state, "open");

  // A real summary is accepted and persisted server-side.
  const summary = "复盘：完成接口联调，并补充了回归测试。";
  const completed = await transition({
    nextState: "done",
    meta: { review: { summary } },
  });
  assert.equal(completed.status, 200);
  assert.equal((completed.body as TaskPayload).task.state, "done");

  const stored = await ctx.request({
    method: "GET",
    path: `/api/app/todo-review/reviews/${taskId}`,
  });
  assert.equal(stored.status, 200);
  const first = (stored.body as ReviewPayload).review;
  assert.ok(first);
  assert.equal(first.taskId, taskId);
  assert.equal(first.summary, summary);

  // Reopening is allowed without a review, completing again is not.
  const reopened = await transition({ nextState: "open" });
  assert.equal(reopened.status, 200);
  assert.equal((reopened.body as TaskPayload).task.state, "open");

  const missingAgain = await transition({ nextState: "done" });
  assert.equal(missingAgain.status, 422);

  const secondSummary = "复盘：第二轮完成前的补充验证。";
  const completedAgain = await transition({
    nextState: "done",
    meta: { review: secondSummary },
  });
  assert.equal(completedAgain.status, 200);

  const refreshed = await ctx.request({
    method: "GET",
    path: `/api/app/todo-review/reviews/${taskId}`,
  });
  const latest = (refreshed.body as ReviewPayload).review;
  assert.ok(latest);
  assert.equal(latest.summary, secondSummary);
  assert.equal(latest.createdAt, first.createdAt);
  assert.ok(latest.updatedAt >= first.updatedAt);

  const missingTask = await ctx.request({
    method: "GET",
    path: "/api/app/todo-review/reviews/unknown-task-id",
  });
  assert.equal(missingTask.status, 200);
  assert.equal((missingTask.body as ReviewPayload).review, null);

  const catalog = await ctx.request({
    method: "GET",
    path: "/api/app/todo-review/reviews",
  });
  assert.equal(catalog.status, 200);
  assert.ok(
    (catalog.body as ReviewListPayload).reviews.some(
      (review) => review.taskId === taskId && review.summary === secondSummary,
    ),

}
```

```
export type TaskState = "open" | "done";

export interface UpdateTaskPatch {
  readonly title?: string;
  readonly notes?: string;
}

export interface BeforeTransitionPayload {
  readonly task: TaskItem;
  readonly nextState: TaskState;
  /** Caller supplied extension metadata; bail listeners may validate/enrich it. */
  readonly meta?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export interface TodoService {
  list(filter?: { readonly state?: TaskState }): TaskItem[];
  get(id: string): TaskItem | null;
  create(input: string | CreateTaskInput): TaskItem;
  update(id: string, patch: UpdateTaskPatch): TaskItem | null;
  delete(id: string): boolean;
  transition(
    id: string,
    nextState: TaskState,
    meta?: Record<string, unknown>,
  ): Promise<TaskItem>;
}

declare module "cordis" {
  interface Context {
    todo: TodoService;
  }
  interface Events {
    "todo:before-transition"(
      payload: BeforeTransitionPayload,
    ): Promise<void | false | string> | void | false | string;
    "todo:changed"(task: TaskItem): void;
  }
}

export interface TodoListSlotContext {
  readonly tasks: readonly TaskItem[];
  readonly filter: "open" | "done" | "all";
  readonly refresh: () => Promise<void>;

  readonly task: TaskItem;

 * `meta` is mutable: interceptors may enrich it before the HTTP request leaves

  readonly task: TaskItem;
  readonly nextState: TaskState;
  readonly meta: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export type TodoTransitionInterceptor = (

) => TodoTransitionInterceptorVerdict | Promise<TodoTransitionInterceptorVerdict>;

}
```

```ts
export default class TodoReviewService extends Service implements ReviewService {
```
```ts
  private readonly db: ScopedDb;
  constructor(ctx: Context) {
    super(ctx, "todoReview");
    this.db = ctx.db;
    this.db.exec(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS plg_todo_review__reviews (...)`);
    ctx.http.route("GET", "/reviews", () => ({ reviews: this.list() }));
    ctx.http.route("GET", "/reviews/:taskId", (req) => ({ review: this.get(req.params.taskId) }));
```
```ts
    const events = ctx as unknown as EventBus;
    events.on("todo:before-transition", (payload) => this.beforeTransition(payload as TransitionPayload));
  }

  get(taskId): Review | null {...}

  private beforeTransition(payload: TransitionPayload): string | void {
    if (!payload || payload.nextState !== "done") return;
    const taskId = payload.task?.id;
    if (typeof taskId !== "string" || taskId.length === 0) return;
    const summary = extractSummary(payload.meta);
    if (summary === null) return "完成任务前必须填写复盘总结";
    if (summary.length === 0) return "复盘总结不能为空";
    if (summary.length > MAX_SUMMARY_LENGTH) return `复盘总结最多 ${MAX_SUMMARY_LENGTH} 个字符`;
```

```ts
import { Service, type Context } from "cordis";
import type { ScopedDb } from "@host/server-sdk";
import type { Review, ReviewService } from "./contract.d.ts";

const MAX_SUMMARY_LENGTH = 2000;
const REVIEW_COLUMNS = "task_id, task_title, summary, created_at, updated_at";

interface ReviewRow {
  readonly task_id: string;
  readonly task_title: string;
  readonly summary: string;
  readonly created_at: string;
  readonly updated_at: string;
}

interface TransitionPayload {
  readonly task?: { readonly id?: unknown; readonly title?: unknown };
  readonly nextState?: unknown;
  readonly meta?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

interface EventBus {
  on(event: string, listener: (payload: unknown) => unknown): unknown;
  emit(event: string, payload: unknown): unknown;
}

function toReview(row: ReviewRow): Review {
  return {
    taskId: row.task_id,
    taskTitle: row.task_title,
    summary: row.summary,
    createdAt: row.created_at,
    updatedAt: row.updated_at,
  };
}

/** Reads the generic `meta.review` extension: a plain string or `{ summary }`. */
function extractSummary(meta: Record<string, unknown> | undefined): string | null {
  if (!meta) return null;
  const raw = meta.review;
  if (typeof raw === "string") return raw.trim();
  if (raw && typeof raw === "object") {
    const summary = (raw as { readonly summary?: unknown }).summary;
    if (typeof summary === "string") return summary.trim();
  }
  return null;
}

export default class TodoReviewService extends Service implements ReviewService {
  private readonly db: ScopedDb;
  private readonly events: EventBus;

  constructor(ctx: Context) {
    super(ctx, "todoReview");
    this.db = ctx.db;
    this.events = ctx as unknown as EventBus;

    this.db.exec(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS plg_todo_review__reviews (
        task_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        task_title TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        summary TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      )
    `);

    ctx.http.route("GET", "/reviews", () => ({ reviews: this.list() }));
    ctx.http.route("GET", "/reviews/:taskId", (req) => ({
      review: this.get(req.params.taskId),
    }));

    // Generic todo-core seam: validate/record before the transition is applied.
    this.events.on("todo:before-transition", (payload) =>
      this.beforeTransition(payload as TransitionPayload),
    );
  }

  list(): Review[] {
    const rows = this.db
      .prepare(
        `SELECT ${REVIEW_COLUMNS} FROM plg_todo_review__reviews ORDER BY updated_at DESC, task_id ASC`,
      )
      .all<ReviewRow>();
    return rows.map(toReview);
  }

  get(taskId: string): Review | null {
    const row = this.db
      .prepare(
        `SELECT ${REVIEW_COLUMNS} FROM plg_todo_review__reviews WHERE task_id = ?`,
      )
      .get<ReviewRow>(taskId);
    return row ? toReview(row) : null;
  }

  private beforeTransition(payload: TransitionPayload): string | void {
    if (!payload || payload.nextState !== "done") return;
    const taskId = payload.task?.id;
    if (typeof taskId !== "string" || taskId.length === 0) return;

    const summary = extractSummary(payload.meta);
    if (summary === null) {
      return "完成任务前必须填写复盘总结";
    }
    if (summary.length === 0) {
      return "复盘总结不能为空";
    }
    if (summary.length > MAX_SUMMARY_LENGTH) {
      return `复盘总结最多 ${MAX_SUMMARY_LENGTH} 个字符`;
    }

    const title =
      typeof payload.task?.title === "string" ? payload.task.title : "";
    this.record(taskId, title, summary);
  }

  private record(taskId: string, taskTitle: string, summary: string): void {
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const existing = this.get(taskId);
    const title = taskTitle.length > 0 ? taskTitle : (existing?.taskTitle ?? "");
    this.db
      .prepare(
        `INSERT INTO plg_todo_review__reviews (task_id, task_title, summary, created_at, updated_at)
         VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
         ON CONFLICT(task_id) DO UPDATE SET
           task_title = excluded.task_title,
           summary = excluded.summary,
           updated_at = excluded.updated_at`,
      )
      .run(taskId, title, summary, existing?.createdAt ?? now, now);

    const review = this.get(taskId);
    if (review) this.events.emit("review:recorded", review);
  }
}
```

```ts
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import type { PluginTestContext } from "@host/server-sdk";

interface TaskPayload {
  readonly task: { readonly id: string; readonly state: string };
}

interface ReviewPayload {
  readonly review:
    | {
        readonly taskId: string;
        readonly summary: string;
        readonly createdAt: string;
        readonly updatedAt: string;
      }
    | null;
}

interface ReviewListPayload {
  readonly reviews: ReadonlyArray<{ readonly taskId: string; readonly summary: string }>;
}

export default async function (ctx: PluginTestContext): Promise<void> {
  const created = await ctx.request({
    method: "POST",
    path: "/api/app/todo-core/tasks",
    body: { title: "Review gated task" },
  });
  assert.equal(created.status, 201);
  const taskId = (created.body as TaskPayload).task.id;

  const transition = (body: Record<string, unknown>) =>
    ctx.request({
      method: "POST",
      path: `/api/app/todo-core/tasks/${taskId}/transition`,
      body,
    });

  // The server rejects completion without a review summary.
  const missing = await transition({ nextState: "done" });
  assert.equal(missing.status, 422);

  const blank = await transition({
    nextState: "done",
    meta: { review: { summary: "   " } },
  });
  assert.equal(blank.status, 422);

  const invalid = await transition({
    nextState: "done",
    meta: { review: 42 },
  });
  assert.equal(invalid.status, 422);

  const stillOpen = await ctx.request({
    method: "GET",
    path: `/api/app/todo-core/tasks/${taskId}`,
  });
  assert.equal((stillOpen.body as TaskPayload).task.state, "open");

  // A real summary is accepted and persisted server-side.
  const summary = "复盘：完成接口联调，并补充了回归测试。";
  const completed = await transition({
    nextState: "done",
    meta: { review: { summary } },
  });
  assert.equal(completed.status, 200);
  assert.equal((completed.body as TaskPayload).task.state, "done");

  const stored = await ctx.request({
    method: "GET",
    path: `/api/app/todo-review/reviews/${taskId}`,
  });
  assert.equal(stored.status, 200);
  const first = (stored.body as ReviewPayload).review;
  assert.ok(first);
  assert.equal(first.taskId, taskId);
  assert.equal(first.summary, summary);

  // Reopening is allowed without a review, completing again is not.
  const reopened = await transition({ nextState: "open" });
  assert.equal(reopened.status, 200);
  assert.equal((reopened.body as TaskPayload).task.state, "open");

  const missingAgain = await transition({ nextState: "done" });
  assert.equal(missingAgain.status, 422);

  const secondSummary = "复盘：第二轮完成前的补充验证。";
  const completedAgain = await transition({
    nextState: "done",
    meta: { review: secondSummary },
  });
  assert.equal(completedAgain.status, 200);

  const refreshed = await ctx.request({
    method: "GET",
    path: `/api/app/todo-review/reviews/${taskId}`,

  const latest = (refreshed.body as ReviewPayload).review;
  assert.ok(latest);
  assert.equal(latest.summary, secondSummary);
  assert.equal(latest.createdAt, first.createdAt);
  assert.ok(latest.updatedAt >= first.updatedAt);

  const missingTask = await ctx.request({

    path: "/api/app/todo-review/reviews/unknown-task-id",
  });
  assert.equal(missingTask.status, 200);
  assert.equal((missingTask.body as ReviewPayload).review, null);

  const catalog = await ctx.request({
    method: "GET",
    path: "/api/app/todo-review/reviews",
  });
  assert.equal(catalog.status, 200);
  assert.ok(

}
```

```tsx
export function TodoReviewGuard({ registerTransitionInterceptor }: TodoReviewGuardSlotProps) {
  const [pending, setPending] = useState<PendingRequest | null>(null);
  const [summary, setSummary] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const pendingRef = useRef<PendingRequest | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof registerTransitionInterceptor !== "function") return;
    return registerTransitionInterceptor(async ({ task, nextState, meta }) => {
      if (nextState !== "done") return;
      if (summaryFromMeta(meta) !== null) return; // already collected upstream
      const collected = await new Promise<string | null>((resolve) => {
        const request = { taskId: task.id, title: task.title ?? "该任务", resolve };
        pendingRef.current = request;
        setSummary("");
        setError("");
        setPending(request);
      });
      pendingRef.current = null;
      if (collected === null) return "已取消复盘，任务未完成";
      meta.review = { summary: collected };
    });
  }, [registerTransitionInterceptor]);

  const settle = (value: string | null) => {
    const request = pendingRef.current;
    pendingRef.current = null;
    setPending(null);
    request?.resolve(value);

  const handleSubmit = () => {
    const text = summary.trim();
    if (!text) { setError("请填写复盘总结后再完成任务"); return; }
    if (text.length > 2000) { setError("复盘总结最多 2000 个字符"); return; }
    settle(text);
  };

  if (!pending) return null;

  return (

        error

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```ts
import { Service, type Context } from "cordis";
import type { ScopedDb } from "@host/server-sdk";
import type { Review, ReviewService } from "./contract.d.ts";

const MAX_SUMMARY_LENGTH = 2000;
const REVIEW_COLUMNS = "task_id, task_title, summary, created_at, updated_at";

interface ReviewRow {
  readonly task_id: string;
  readonly task_title: string;
  readonly summary: string;
  readonly created_at: string;
  readonly updated_at: string;
}

interface TransitionPayload {
  readonly task?: { readonly id?: unknown; readonly title?: unknown };
  readonly nextState?: unknown;
  readonly meta?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

interface EventBus {
  on(event: string, listener: (payload: unknown) => unknown): unknown;
  emit(event: string, payload: unknown): unknown;
}

function toReview(row: ReviewRow): Review {
  return {
    taskId: row.task_id,
    taskTitle: row.task_title,
    summary: row.summary,
    createdAt: row.created_at,
    updatedAt: row.updated_at,
  };
}

/** Reads the generic `meta.review` extension: a plain string or `{ summary }`. */
function extractSummary(meta: Record<string, unknown> | undefined): string | null {
  if (!meta) return null;
  const raw = meta.review;
  if (typeof raw === "string") return raw.trim();
  if (raw && typeof raw === "object") {
    const summary = (raw as { readonly summary?: unknown }).summary;
    if (typeof summary === "string") return summary.trim();
  }
  return null;
}

export default class TodoReviewService extends Service implements ReviewService {
  private readonly db: ScopedDb;
  private readonly events: EventBus;

  constructor(ctx: Context) {
    super(ctx, "todoReview");
    this.db = ctx.db;
    this.events = ctx as unknown as EventBus;

    this.db.exec(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS plg_todo_review__reviews (
        task_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        task_title TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        summary TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      )
    `);

    ctx.http.route("GET", "/reviews", () => ({ reviews: this.list() }));
    ctx.http.route("GET", "/reviews/:taskId", (req) => ({
      review: this.get(req.params.taskId),
    }));

    // Generic todo-core seam: validate/record before the transition is applied.
    this.events.on("todo:before-transition", (payload) =>
      this.beforeTransition(payload as TransitionPayload),
    );
  }

  list(): Review[] {
    const rows = this.db
      .prepare(
        `SELECT ${REVIEW_COLUMNS} FROM plg_todo_review__reviews ORDER BY updated_at DESC, task_id ASC`,
      )
      .all<ReviewRow>();
    return rows.map(toReview);
  }

  get(taskId: string): Review | null {
    const row = this.db
      .prepare(
        `SELECT ${REVIEW_COLUMNS} FROM plg_todo_review__reviews WHERE task_id = ?`,
      )
      .get<ReviewRow>(taskId);
    return row ? toReview(row) : null;
  }

  private beforeTransition(payload: TransitionPayload): string | void {
    if (!payload || payload.nextState !== "done") return;
    const taskId = payload.task?.id;
    if (typeof taskId !== "string" || taskId.length === 0) return;

    const summary = extractSummary(payload.meta);
    if (summary === null) {
      return "完成任务前必须填写复盘总结";
    }
    if (summary.length === 0) {
      return "复盘总结不能为空";
    }
    if (summary.length > MAX_SUMMARY_LENGTH) {
      return `复盘总结最多 ${MAX_SUMMARY_LENGTH} 个字符`;
    }

    const title =
      typeof payload.task?.title === "string" ? payload.task.title : "";
    this.record(taskId, title, summary);
  }

  private record(taskId: string, taskTitle: string, summary: string): void {
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const existing = this.get(taskId);
    const title = taskTitle.length > 0 ? taskTitle : (existing?.taskTitle ?? "");
    this.db
      .prepare(
        `INSERT INTO plg_todo_review__reviews (task_id, task_title, summary, created_at, updated_at)
         VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
         ON CONFLICT(task_id) DO UPDATE SET
           task_title = excluded.task_title,
           summary = excluded.summary,
           updated_at = excluded.updated_at`,
      )
      .run(taskId, title, summary, existing?.createdAt ?? now, now);

    const review = this.get(taskId);
    if (review) this.events.emit("review:recorded", review);
  }
}
```

```ts
  assert.equal(blank.status, 422);

    meta: { review: 42 },

  assert.equal(invalid.status, 422);

  assert.equal((stillOpen.body as TaskPayload).task.state, "open");

  assert.equal((completed.body as TaskPayload).task.state, "done");
```

```ts
import { Service, type Context } from "cordis";
import type { ScopedDb } from "@host/server-sdk";
import type { Review, ReviewService } from "./contract.d.ts";

const MAX_SUMMARY_LENGTH = 2000;
```
```ts
const REVIEW_COLUMNS = "task_id, task_title, summary, created_at, updated_at";
```

```ts
interface ReviewRow {
  readonly task_id: string;
  readonly task_title: string;
  readonly summary: string;
  readonly created_at: string;
  readonly updated_at: string;
}

interface TransitionPayload {
  readonly task?: { readonly id?: unknown; readonly title?: unknown };
  readonly nextState?: unknown;
  readonly meta?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

interface EventBus {
  on(event: string, listener: (payload: unknown) => unknown): unknown;
  emit(event: string, payload: unknown): unknown;
}

function toReview(row: ReviewRow): Review {
  return {
    taskId: row.task_id,
    taskTitle: row.task_title,
    summary: row.summary,
    createdAt: row.created_at,
    updatedAt: row.updated_at,
  };
}

/** Reads the generic `meta.review` extension: a plain string or `{ summary }`. */
function extractSummary(meta: Record<string, unknown> | undefined): string | null {
  if (!meta) return null;
  const raw = meta.review;
  if (typeof raw === "string") return raw.trim();
  if (raw && typeof raw === "object") {
    const summary = (raw as { readonly summary?: unknown }).summary;
    if (typeof summary === "string") return summary.trim();
  }
  return null;
}

export default class TodoReviewService extends Service implements ReviewService {
  private readonly db: ScopedDb;
  private readonly events: EventBus;

  constructor(ctx: Context) {
    super(ctx, "todoReview");
    this.db = ctx.db;
    this.events = ctx as unknown as EventBus;

    this.db.exec(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS plg_todo_review__reviews (
        task_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        task_title TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        summary TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      )
    `);

    ctx.http.route("GET", "/reviews", () => ({ reviews: this.list() }));
    ctx.http.route("GET", "/reviews/:taskId", (req) => ({
      review: this.get(req.params.taskId),
    }));

    // Generic todo-core seam: validate/record before the transition is applied.
    this.events.on("todo:before-transition", (payload) =>
      this.beforeTransition(payload as TransitionPayload),
    );
  }

  list(): Review[] {
    const rows = this.db
      .prepare(
        `SELECT ${REVIEW_COLUMNS} FROM plg_todo_review__reviews ORDER BY updated_at DESC, task_id ASC`,
      )
      .all<ReviewRow>();
    return rows.map(toReview);
  }

  get(taskId: string): Review | null {
    const row = this.db
      .prepare(
        `SELECT ${REVIEW_COLUMNS} FROM plg_todo_review__reviews WHERE task_id = ?`,
      )
      .get<ReviewRow>(taskId);
    return row ? toReview(row) : null;
  }

  private beforeTransition(payload: TransitionPayload): string | void {
    if (!payload || payload.nextState !== "done") return;
    const taskId = payload.task?.id;
    if (typeof taskId !== "string" || taskId.length === 0) return;

    const summary = extractSummary(payload.meta);
    if (summary === null) {
      return "完成任务前必须填写复盘总结";
    }
    if (summary.length === 0) {
      return "复盘总结不能为空";
    }
    if (summary.length > MAX_SUMMARY_LENGTH) {
      return `复盘总结最多 ${MAX_SUMMARY_LENGTH} 个字符`;
    }

    const title =
      typeof payload.task?.title === "string" ? payload.task.title : "";
    this.record(taskId, title, summary);
  }

  private record(taskId: string, taskTitle: string, summary: string): void {
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const existing = this.get(taskId);
    const title = taskTitle.length > 0 ? taskTitle : (existing?.taskTitle ?? "");
    this.db
      .prepare(
        `INSERT INTO plg_todo_review__reviews (task_id, task_title, summary, created_at, updated_at)
         VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
         ON CONFLICT(task_id) DO UPDATE SET
           task_title = excluded.task_title,
           summary = excluded.summary,
           updated_at = excluded.updated_at`,
      )
      .run(taskId, title, summary, existing?.createdAt ?? now, now);

    const review = this.get(taskId);
    if (review) this.events.emit("review:recorded", review);
  }
}
```

```
import type {} from "cordis";

export type TaskState = "open" | "done";

export interface TaskItem {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly title: string;
  readonly notes: string;
  readonly state: TaskState;
  readonly createdAt: string;
  readonly updatedAt: string;
}

export interface CreateTaskInput {
  readonly title: string;
  readonly notes?: string;
}

export interface UpdateTaskPatch {
  readonly title?: string;
  readonly notes?: string;
}

export interface BeforeTransitionPayload {
  readonly task: TaskItem;
  readonly nextState: TaskState;
  /** Caller supplied extension metadata; bail listeners may validate/enrich it. */
  readonly meta?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export interface TodoService {
  list(filter?: { readonly state?: TaskState }): TaskItem[];
  get(id: string): TaskItem | null;
  create(input: string | CreateTaskInput): TaskItem;
  update(id: string, patch: UpdateTaskPatch): TaskItem | null;
  delete(id: string): boolean;
  transition(
    id: string,
    nextState: TaskState,
    meta?: Record<string, unknown>,
  ): Promise<TaskItem>;
}

declare module "cordis" {
  interface Context {
    todo: TodoService;
  }
  interface Events {
    "todo:before-transition"(
      payload: BeforeTransitionPayload,
    ): Promise<void | false | string> | void | false | string;
    "todo:changed"(task: TaskItem): void;
  }
}

export interface TodoListSlotContext {
  readonly tasks: readonly TaskItem[];
  readonly filter: "open" | "done" | "all";
  readonly refresh: () => Promise<void>;
}

export interface TodoItemSlotContext {
  readonly task: TaskItem;
  readonly refresh: () => Promise<void>;
}

/**
 * Input handed to a generic client-side transition interceptor.
 * `meta` is mutable: interceptors may enrich it before the HTTP request leaves
 * the browser, and the server side `todo:before-transition` listeners see it.
 */
export interface TodoTransitionInterceptorInput {
  readonly task: TaskItem;
  readonly nextState: TaskState;
  readonly meta: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export type TodoTransitionInterceptorVerdict = void | false | string;

export type TodoTransitionInterceptor = (
  input: TodoTransitionInterceptorInput,
) => TodoTransitionInterceptorVerdict | Promise<TodoTransitionInterceptorVerdict>;

/**
 * Client half of the generic dual-end transition seam. Components mounted into
 * `todo.transition.guard` register interceptors imperatively; todo-core owns
 * the ordering/verdict handling while the feature logic stays in the plugin.
 */
export interface TodoTransitionGuardSlotContext {
  readonly registerTransitionInterceptor: (
    interceptor: TodoTransitionInterceptor,
  ) => () => void;
}

declare module "@host/client-sdk" {
  interface SlotPropsMap {
    "todo.header.actions": TodoListSlotContext;
    "todo.sidebar.sections": TodoListSlotContext;
    "todo.list.banner": TodoListSlotContext;
    "todo.item.badges": TodoItemSlotContext;
    "todo.item.detail": TodoItemSlotContext;
    "todo.transition.guard": TodoTransitionGuardSlotContext;
  }
}
```

```ts
    this.record(taskId, typeof payload.task?.title === "string" ? payload.task.title : "", summary);
  }

  private record(taskId, taskTitle, summary) {
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    this.db.prepare(`INSERT INTO ... VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(task_id) DO UPDATE SET task_title = excluded.task_title, summary = excluded.summary, updated_at = excluded.updated_at`).run(taskId, taskTitle, summary, now, now);
```

```ts
import { Service, type Context } from "cordis";
import type { ScopedDb } from "@host/server-sdk";
import type { Review, ReviewService } from "./contract.d.ts";

const MAX_SUMMARY_LENGTH = 2000;
const REVIEW_COLUMNS = "task_id, task_title, summary, created_at, updated_at";

interface ReviewRow {
  readonly task_id: string;
  readonly task_title: string;
  readonly summary: string;
  readonly created_at: string;
  readonly updated_at: string;
}

interface TransitionPayload {
  readonly task?: { readonly id?: unknown; readonly title?: unknown };
  readonly nextState?: unknown;
  readonly meta?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

interface EventBus {
  on(event: string, listener: (payload: unknown) => unknown): unknown;
  emit(event: string, payload: unknown): unknown;
}

function toReview(row: ReviewRow): Review {
  return {
    taskId: row.task_id,
    taskTitle: row.task_title,
    summary: row.summary,
    createdAt: row.created_at,
    updatedAt: row.updated_at,
  };
}

/** Reads the generic `meta.review` extension: a plain string or `{ summary }`. */
function extractSummary(meta: Record<string, unknown> | undefined): string | null {
  if (!meta) return null;
  const raw = meta.review;
  if (typeof raw === "string") return raw.trim();
  if (raw && typeof raw === "object") {
    const summary = (raw as { readonly summary?: unknown }).summary;
    if (typeof summary === "string") return summary.trim();
  }
  return null;
}

export default class TodoReviewService extends Service implements ReviewService {
  private readonly db: ScopedDb;
  private readonly events: EventBus;

  constructor(ctx: Context) {
    super(ctx, "todoReview");
    this.db = ctx.db;
    this.events = ctx as unknown as EventBus;

    this.db.exec(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS plg_todo_review__reviews (
        task_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        task_title TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        summary TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      )
    `);

    ctx.http.route("GET", "/reviews", () => ({ reviews: this.list() }));
    ctx.http.route("GET", "/reviews/:taskId", (req) => ({
      review: this.get(req.params.taskId),
    }));

    // Generic todo-core seam: validate/record before the transition is applied.
    this.events.on("todo:before-transition", (payload) =>
      this.beforeTransition(payload as TransitionPayload),
    );
  }

  list(): Review[] {
    const rows = this.db
      .prepare(
        `SELECT ${REVIEW_COLUMNS} FROM plg_todo_review__reviews ORDER BY updated_at DESC, task_id ASC`,
      )
      .all<ReviewRow>();
    return rows.map(toReview);
  }

  get(taskId: string): Review | null {
    const row = this.db
      .prepare(
        `SELECT ${REVIEW_COLUMNS} FROM plg_todo_review__reviews WHERE task_id = ?`,
      )
      .get<ReviewRow>(taskId);
    return row ? toReview(row) : null;
  }

  private beforeTransition(payload: TransitionPayload): string | void {
    if (!payload || payload.nextState !== "done") return;
    const taskId = payload.task?.id;
    if (typeof taskId !== "string" || taskId.length === 0) return;

    const summary = extractSummary(payload.meta);
    if (summary === null) {
      return "完成任务前必须填写复盘总结";
    }
    if (summary.length === 0) {
      return "复盘总结不能为空";
    }
    if (summary.length > MAX_SUMMARY_LENGTH) {
      return `复盘总结最多 ${MAX_SUMMARY_LENGTH} 个字符`;
    }

    const title =
      typeof payload.task?.title === "string" ? payload.task.title : "";
    this.record(taskId, title, summary);
  }

  private record(taskId: string, taskTitle: string, summary: string): void {
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const existing = this.get(taskId);
    const title = taskTitle.length > 0 ? taskTitle : (existing?.taskTitle ?? "");
    this.db
      .prepare(
        `INSERT INTO plg_todo_review__reviews (task_id, task_title, summary, created_at, updated_at)
         VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
         ON CONFLICT(task_id) DO UPDATE SET
           task_title = excluded.task_title,
           summary = excluded.summary,
           updated_at = excluded.updated_at`,
      )
      .run(taskId, title, summary, existing?.createdAt ?? now, now);

    const review = this.get(taskId);
    if (review) this.events.emit("review:recorded", review);
  }
}
```

```
import type {} from "cordis";

export type TaskState = "open" | "done";

export interface TaskItem {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly title: string;
  readonly notes: string;
  readonly state: TaskState;
  readonly createdAt: string;
  readonly updatedAt: string;
}

export interface CreateTaskInput {
  readonly title: string;
  readonly notes?: string;
}

export interface UpdateTaskPatch {
  readonly title?: string;
  readonly notes?: string;
}

export interface BeforeTransitionPayload {
  readonly task: TaskItem;
  readonly nextState: TaskState;
  /** Caller supplied extension metadata; bail listeners may validate/enrich it. */
  readonly meta?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export interface TodoService {
  list(filter?: { readonly state?: TaskState }): TaskItem[];
  get(id: string): TaskItem | null;
  create(input: string | CreateTaskInput): TaskItem;
  update(id: string, patch: UpdateTaskPatch): TaskItem | null;
  delete(id: string): boolean;
  transition(
    id: string,
    nextState: TaskState,
    meta?: Record<string, unknown>,
  ): Promise<TaskItem>;
}

declare module "cordis" {
  interface Context {
    todo: TodoService;
  }
  interface Events {
    "todo:before-transition"(
      payload: BeforeTransitionPayload,
    ): Promise<void | false | string> | void | false | string;
    "todo:changed"(task: TaskItem): void;
  }
}

export interface TodoListSlotContext {
  readonly tasks: readonly TaskItem[];
  readonly filter: "open" | "done" | "all";
  readonly refresh: () => Promise<void>;
}

export interface TodoItemSlotContext {
  readonly task: TaskItem;
  readonly refresh: () => Promise<void>;
}

/**
 * Input handed to a generic client-side transition interceptor.
 * `meta` is mutable: interceptors may enrich it before the HTTP request leaves
 * the browser, and the server side `todo:before-transition` listeners see it.
 */
export interface TodoTransitionInterceptorInput {
  readonly task: TaskItem;
  readonly nextState: TaskState;
  readonly meta: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export type TodoTransitionInterceptorVerdict = void | false | string;

export type TodoTransitionInterceptor = (
  input: TodoTransitionInterceptorInput,
) => TodoTransitionInterceptorVerdict | Promise<TodoTransitionInterceptorVerdict>;

/**
 * Client half of the generic dual-end transition seam. Components mounted into
 * `todo.transition.guard` register interceptors imperatively; todo-core owns
 * the ordering/verdict handling while the feature logic stays in the plugin.
 */
export interface TodoTransitionGuardSlotContext {
  readonly registerTransitionInterceptor: (
    interceptor: TodoTransitionInterceptor,
  ) => () => void;
}

declare module "@host/client-sdk" {
  interface SlotPropsMap {
    "todo.header.actions": TodoListSlotContext;
    "todo.sidebar.sections": TodoListSlotContext;
    "todo.list.banner": TodoListSlotContext;
    "todo.item.badges": TodoItemSlotContext;
    "todo.item.detail": TodoItemSlotContext;
    "todo.transition.guard": TodoTransitionGuardSlotContext;
  }
}
```

```ts
export default class TodoReviewService extends Service implements ReviewService {
```
```ts
  private readonly db: ScopedDb;
  constructor(ctx: Context) {
    super(ctx, "todoReview");
    this.db = ctx.db;
    this.db.exec(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS plg_todo_review__reviews (...)`);
    ctx.http.route("GET", "/reviews", () => ({ reviews: this.list() }));
    ctx.http.route("GET", "/reviews/:taskId", (req) => ({ review: this.get(req.params.taskId) }));
```
```ts
    const events = ctx as unknown as EventBus;
    events.on("todo:before-transition", (payload) => this.beforeTransition(payload as TransitionPayload));
  }

  get(taskId): Review | null {...}

  private beforeTransition(payload: TransitionPayload): string | void {
    if (!payload || payload.nextState !== "done") return;
    const taskId = payload.task?.id;
    if (typeof taskId !== "string" || taskId.length === 0) return;
    const summary = extractSummary(payload.meta);
    if (summary === null) return "完成任务前必须填写复盘总结";
    if (summary.length === 0) return "复盘总结不能为空";
    if (summary.length > MAX_SUMMARY_LENGTH) return `复盘总结最多 ${MAX_SUMMARY_LENGTH} 个字符`;
    this.record(taskId, typeof payload.task?.title === "string" ? payload.task.title : "", summary);
  }

  private record(taskId, taskTitle, summary) {
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    this.db.prepare(`INSERT INTO ... VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(task_id) DO UPDATE SET task_title = excluded.task_title, summary = excluded.summary, updated_at = excluded.updated_at`).run(taskId, taskTitle, summary, now, now);
    const review = this.get(taskId);
    if (review) (this.ctx as unknown as EventBus).emit("review:recorded", review);
  }
}
```

```ts
import { Service, type Context } from "cordis";
import type { ScopedDb } from "@host/server-sdk";
import type { Review, ReviewService } from "./contract.d.ts";

const MAX_SUMMARY_LENGTH = 2000;
const REVIEW_COLUMNS = "task_id, task_title, summary, created_at, updated_at";

interface ReviewRow {
  readonly task_id: string;
  readonly task_title: string;
  readonly summary: string;
  readonly created_at: string;
  readonly updated_at: string;
}

interface TransitionPayload {
  readonly task?: { readonly id?: unknown; readonly title?: unknown };
  readonly nextState?: unknown;
  readonly meta?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

interface EventBus {
  on(event: string, listener: (payload: unknown) => unknown): unknown;
  emit(event: string, payload: unknown): unknown;
}

function toReview(row: ReviewRow): Review {
  return {
    taskId: row.task_id,
    taskTitle: row.task_title,
    summary: row.summary,
    createdAt: row.created_at,
    updatedAt: row.updated_at,
  };
}

/** Reads the generic `meta.review` extension: a plain string or `{ summary }`. */
function extractSummary(meta: Record<string, unknown> | undefined): string | null {
  if (!meta) return null;
  const raw = meta.review;
  if (typeof raw === "string") return raw.trim();
  if (raw && typeof raw === "object") {
    const summary = (raw as { readonly summary?: unknown }).summary;
    if (typeof summary === "string") return summary.trim();
  }
  return null;
}

export default class TodoReviewService extends Service implements ReviewService {
  private readonly db: ScopedDb;
  private readonly events: EventBus;

  constructor(ctx: Context) {
    super(ctx, "todoReview");
    this.db = ctx.db;
    this.events = ctx as unknown as EventBus;

    this.db.exec(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS plg_todo_review__reviews (
        task_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        task_title TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        summary TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      )
    `);

    ctx.http.route("GET", "/reviews", () => ({ reviews: this.list() }));
    ctx.http.route("GET", "/reviews/:taskId", (req) => ({
      review: this.get(req.params.taskId),
    }));

    // Generic todo-core seam: validate/record before the transition is applied.
    this.events.on("todo:before-transition", (payload) =>
      this.beforeTransition(payload as TransitionPayload),
    );
  }

  list(): Review[] {
    const rows = this.db
      .prepare(
        `SELECT ${REVIEW_COLUMNS} FROM plg_todo_review__reviews ORDER BY updated_at DESC, task_id ASC`,
      )
      .all<ReviewRow>();
    return rows.map(toReview);
  }

  get(taskId: string): Review | null {
    const row = this.db
      .prepare(
        `SELECT ${REVIEW_COLUMNS} FROM plg_todo_review__reviews WHERE task_id = ?`,
      )
      .get<ReviewRow>(taskId);
    return row ? toReview(row) : null;
  }

  private beforeTransition(payload: TransitionPayload): string | void {
    if (!payload || payload.nextState !== "done") return;
    const taskId = payload.task?.id;
    if (typeof taskId !== "string" || taskId.length === 0) return;

    const summary = extractSummary(payload.meta);
    if (summary === null) {
      return "完成任务前必须填写复盘总结";
    }
    if (summary.length === 0) {
      return "复盘总结不能为空";
    }
    if (summary.length > MAX_SUMMARY_LENGTH) {
      return `复盘总结最多 ${MAX_SUMMARY_LENGTH} 个字符`;
    }

    const title =
      typeof payload.task?.title === "string" ? payload.task.title : "";
    this.record(taskId, title, summary);
  }

  private record(taskId: string, taskTitle: string, summary: string): void {
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const existing = this.get(taskId);
    const title = taskTitle.length > 0 ? taskTitle : (existing?.taskTitle ?? "");
    this.db
      .prepare(
        `INSERT INTO plg_todo_review__reviews (task_id, task_title, summary, created_at, updated_at)
         VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
         ON CONFLICT(task_id) DO UPDATE SET
           task_title = excluded.task_title,
           summary = excluded.summary,
           updated_at = excluded.updated_at`,
      )
      .run(taskId, title, summary, existing?.createdAt ?? now, now);

    const review = this.get(taskId);
    if (review) this.events.emit("review:recorded", review);
  }
}
```

```ts
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import type { PluginTestContext } from "@host/server-sdk";

interface TaskPayload {
  readonly task: { readonly id: string; readonly state: string };
}

interface ReviewPayload {
  readonly review:
    | {
        readonly taskId: string;
        readonly summary: string;
        readonly createdAt: string;
        readonly updatedAt: string;
      }
    | null;
}

interface ReviewListPayload {
  readonly reviews: ReadonlyArray<{ readonly taskId: string; readonly summary: string }>;
}

export default async function (ctx: PluginTestContext): Promise<void> {
  const created = await ctx.request({
    method: "POST",
    path: "/api/app/todo-core/tasks",
    body: { title: "Review gated task" },
  });
  assert.equal(created.status, 201);
  const taskId = (created.body as TaskPayload).task.id;

  const transition = (body: Record<string, unknown>) =>
    ctx.request({
      method: "POST",
      path: `/api/app/todo-core/tasks/${taskId}/transition`,
      body,
    });

  // The server rejects completion without a review summary.
  const missing = await transition({ nextState: "done" });
  assert.equal(missing.status, 422);

  const blank = await transition({
    nextState: "done",
    meta: { review: { summary: "   " } },
  });
  assert.equal(blank.status, 422);

  const invalid = await transition({
    nextState: "done",
    meta: { review: 42 },
  });
  assert.equal(invalid.status, 422);

  const stillOpen = await ctx.request({
    method: "GET",
    path: `/api/app/todo-core/tasks/${taskId}`,
  });
  assert.equal((stillOpen.body as TaskPayload).task.state, "open");

  // A real summary is accepted and persisted server-side.
  const summary = "复盘：完成接口联调，并补充了回归测试。";
  const completed = await transition({
    nextState: "done",
    meta: { review: { summary } },
  });
  assert.equal(completed.status, 200);
  assert.equal((completed.body as TaskPayload).task.state, "done");

  const stored = await ctx.request({
    method: "GET",
    path: `/api/app/todo-review/reviews/${taskId}`,
  });
  assert.equal(stored.status, 200);
  const first = (stored.body as ReviewPayload).review;
  assert.ok(first);
  assert.equal(first.taskId, taskId);
  assert.equal(first.summary, summary);

  // Reopening is allowed without a review, completing again is not.
  const reopened = await transition({ nextState: "open" });
  assert.equal(reopened.status, 200);
  assert.equal((reopened.body as TaskPayload).task.state, "open");

  const missingAgain = await transition({ nextState: "done" });
  assert.equal(missingAgain.status, 422);

  const secondSummary = "复盘：第二轮完成前的补充验证。";
  const completedAgain = await transition({
    nextState: "done",
    meta: { review: secondSummary },
  });
  assert.equal(completedAgain.status, 200);

  const refreshed = await ctx.request({
    method: "GET",
    path: `/api/app/todo-review/reviews/${taskId}`,
  });
  const latest = (refreshed.body as ReviewPayload).review;
  assert.ok(latest);
  assert.equal(latest.summary, secondSummary);
  assert.equal(latest.createdAt, first.createdAt);
  assert.ok(latest.updatedAt >= first.updatedAt);

  const missingTask = await ctx.request({
    method: "GET",
    path: "/api/app/todo-review/reviews/unknown-task-id",
  });
  assert.equal(missingTask.status, 200);
  assert.equal((missingTask.body as ReviewPayload).review, null);

  const catalog = await ctx.request({
    method: "GET",
    path: "/api/app/todo-review/reviews",
  });
  assert.equal(catalog.status, 200);
  assert.ok(
    (catalog.body as ReviewListPayload).reviews.some(
      (review) => review.taskId === taskId && review.summary === secondSummary,
    ),
  );
}
```

```
import type {} from "cordis";

export type TaskState = "open" | "done";

export interface TaskItem {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly title: string;
  readonly notes: string;
  readonly state: TaskState;
  readonly createdAt: string;
  readonly updatedAt: string;
}

export interface CreateTaskInput {
  readonly title: string;
  readonly notes?: string;
}

export interface UpdateTaskPatch {
  readonly title?: string;
  readonly notes?: string;
}

export interface BeforeTransitionPayload {
  readonly task: TaskItem;
  readonly nextState: TaskState;
  /** Caller supplied extension metadata; bail listeners may validate/enrich it. */
  readonly meta?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export interface TodoService {
  list(filter?: { readonly state?: TaskState }): TaskItem[];
  get(id: string): TaskItem | null;
  create(input: string | CreateTaskInput): TaskItem;
  update(id: string, patch: UpdateTaskPatch): TaskItem | null;
  delete(id: string): boolean;
  transition(
    id: string,
    nextState: TaskState,
    meta?: Record<string, unknown>,
  ): Promise<TaskItem>;
}

declare module "cordis" {
  interface Context {
    todo: TodoService;
  }
  interface Events {
    "todo:before-transition"(
      payload: BeforeTransitionPayload,
    ): Promise<void | false | string> | void | false | string;
    "todo:changed"(task: TaskItem): void;
  }
}

export interface TodoListSlotContext {
  readonly tasks: readonly TaskItem[];
  readonly filter: "open" | "done" | "all";
  readonly refresh: () => Promise<void>;
}

export interface TodoItemSlotContext {
  readonly task: TaskItem;
  readonly refresh: () => Promise<void>;
}

/**
 * Input handed to a generic client-side transition interceptor.
 * `meta` is mutable: interceptors may enrich it before the HTTP request leaves
 * the browser, and the server side `todo:before-transition` listeners see it.
 */
export interface TodoTransitionInterceptorInput {
  readonly task: TaskItem;
  readonly nextState: TaskState;
  readonly meta: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export type TodoTransitionInterceptorVerdict = void | false | string;

export type TodoTransitionInterceptor = (
  input: TodoTransitionInterceptorInput,
) => TodoTransitionInterceptorVerdict | Promise<TodoTransitionInterceptorVerdict>;

/**
 * Client half of the generic dual-end transition seam. Components mounted into
 * `todo.transition.guard` register interceptors imperatively; todo-core owns
 * the ordering/verdict handling while the feature logic stays in the plugin.
 */
export interface TodoTransitionGuardSlotContext {
  readonly registerTransitionInterceptor: (
    interceptor: TodoTransitionInterceptor,
  ) => () => void;
}

declare module "@host/client-sdk" {
  interface SlotPropsMap {
    "todo.header.actions": TodoListSlotContext;
    "todo.sidebar.sections": TodoListSlotContext;
    "todo.list.banner": TodoListSlotContext;
    "todo.item.badges": TodoItemSlotContext;
    "todo.item.detail": TodoItemSlotContext;
    "todo.transition.guard": TodoTransitionGuardSlotContext;
  }
}
```

```ts
export default class TodoReviewService extends Service implements ReviewService {
```
```ts
  private readonly db: ScopedDb;
  constructor(ctx: Context) {
    super(ctx, "todoReview");
    this.db = ctx.db;
    this.db.exec(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS plg_todo_review__reviews (...)`);
    ctx.http.route("GET", "/reviews", () => ({ reviews: this.list() }));
    ctx.http.route("GET", "/reviews/:taskId", (req) => ({ review: this.get(req.params.taskId) }));
```
```ts
    const events = ctx as unknown as EventBus;
    events.on("todo:before-transition", (payload) => this.beforeTransition(payload as TransitionPayload));
  }

  list(): Review[] { ... ORDER BY updated_at DESC }
  get(taskId): Review | null {...}

  private beforeTransition(payload: TransitionPayload): string | void {
    if (!payload || payload.nextState !== "done") return;
    const taskId = payload.task?.id;
    if (typeof taskId !== "string" || taskId.length === 0) return;
    const summary = extractSummary(payload.meta);
    if (summary === null) return "完成任务前必须填写复盘总结";
    if (summary.length === 0) return "复盘总结不能为空";
    if (summary.length > MAX_SUMMARY_LENGTH) return `复盘总结最多 ${MAX_SUMMARY_LENGTH} 个字符`;
    this.record(taskId, typeof payload.task?.title === "string" ? payload.task.title : "", summary);
  }

  private record(taskId, taskTitle, summary) {
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    this.db.prepare(`INSERT INTO ... VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(task_id) DO UPDATE SET task_title = excluded.task_title, summary = excluded.summary, updated_at = excluded.updated_at`).run(taskId, taskTitle, summary, now, now);
    const review = this.get(taskId);
    if (review) (this.ctx as unknown as EventBus).emit("review:recorded", review);
  }
}
```

```ts
import { Service, type Context } from "cordis";
import type { ScopedDb } from "@host/server-sdk";
import type { Review, ReviewService } from "./contract.d.ts";

const MAX_SUMMARY_LENGTH = 2000;
const REVIEW_COLUMNS = "task_id, task_title, summary, created_at, updated_at";

interface ReviewRow {
  readonly task_id: string;
  readonly task_title: string;
  readonly summary: string;
  readonly created_at: string;
  readonly updated_at: string;
}

interface TransitionPayload {
  readonly task?: { readonly id?: unknown; readonly title?: unknown };
  readonly nextState?: unknown;
  readonly meta?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

interface EventBus {
  on(event: string, listener: (payload: unknown) => unknown): unknown;
  emit(event: string, payload: unknown): unknown;
}

function toReview(row: ReviewRow): Review {
  return {
    taskId: row.task_id,
    taskTitle: row.task_title,
    summary: row.summary,
    createdAt: row.created_at,
    updatedAt: row.updated_at,
  };
}

/** Reads the generic `meta.review` extension: a plain string or `{ summary }`. */
function extractSummary(meta: Record<string, unknown> | undefined): string | null {
  if (!meta) return null;
  const raw = meta.review;
  if (typeof raw === "string") return raw.trim();
  if (raw && typeof raw === "object") {
    const summary = (raw as { readonly summary?: unknown }).summary;
    if (typeof summary === "string") return summary.trim();
  }
  return null;
}

export default class TodoReviewService extends Service implements ReviewService {
  private readonly db: ScopedDb;
  private readonly events: EventBus;

  constructor(ctx: Context) {
    super(ctx, "todoReview");
    this.db = ctx.db;
    this.events = ctx as unknown as EventBus;

    this.db.exec(`
      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS plg_todo_review__reviews (
        task_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        task_title TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        summary TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      )
    `);

    ctx.http.route("GET", "/reviews", () => ({ reviews: this.list() }));
    ctx.http.route("GET", "/reviews/:taskId", (req) => ({
      review: this.get(req.params.taskId),
    }));

    // Generic todo-core seam: validate/record before the transition is applied.
    this.events.on("todo:before-transition", (payload) =>
      this.beforeTransition(payload as TransitionPayload),
    );
  }

  list(): Review[] {
    const rows = this.db
      .prepare(
        `SELECT ${REVIEW_COLUMNS} FROM plg_todo_review__reviews ORDER BY updated_at DESC, task_id ASC`,
      )
      .all<ReviewRow>();
    return rows.map(toReview);
  }

  get(taskId: string): Review | null {
    const row = this.db
      .prepare(
        `SELECT ${REVIEW_COLUMNS} FROM plg_todo_review__reviews WHERE task_id = ?`,
      )
      .get<ReviewRow>(taskId);
    return row ? toReview(row) : null;
  }

  private beforeTransition(payload: TransitionPayload): string | void {
    if (!payload || payload.nextState !== "done") return;
    const taskId = payload.task?.id;
    if (typeof taskId !== "string" || taskId.length === 0) return;

    const summary = extractSummary(payload.meta);
    if (summary === null) {
      return "完成任务前必须填写复盘总结";
    }
    if (summary.length === 0) {
      return "复盘总结不能为空";
    }
    if (summary.length > MAX_SUMMARY_LENGTH) {
      return `复盘总结最多 ${MAX_SUMMARY_LENGTH} 个字符`;
    }

    const title =
      typeof payload.task?.title === "string" ? payload.task.title : "";
    this.record(taskId, title, summary);
  }

  private record(taskId: string, taskTitle: string, summary: string): void {
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const existing = this.get(taskId);
    const title = taskTitle.length > 0 ? taskTitle : (existing?.taskTitle ?? "");
    this.db
      .prepare(
        `INSERT INTO plg_todo_review__reviews (task_id, task_title, summary, created_at, updated_at)
         VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
         ON CONFLICT(task_id) DO UPDATE SET
           task_title = excluded.task_title,
           summary = excluded.summary,
           updated_at = excluded.updated_at`,
      )
      .run(taskId, title, summary, existing?.createdAt ?? now, now);

    const review = this.get(taskId);
    if (review) this.events.emit("review:recorded", review);
  }
}
```

```
import type {} from "cordis";

export type TaskState = "open" | "done";

export interface TaskItem {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly title: string;
  readonly notes: string;
  readonly state: TaskState;
  readonly createdAt: string;
  readonly updatedAt: string;
}

export interface CreateTaskInput {
  readonly title: string;
  readonly notes?: string;
}

export interface UpdateTaskPatch {
  readonly title?: string;
  readonly notes?: string;
}

export interface BeforeTransitionPayload {
  readonly task: TaskItem;
  readonly nextState: TaskState;
  /** Caller supplied extension metadata; bail listeners may validate/enrich it. */
  readonly meta?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export interface TodoService {
  list(filter?: { readonly state?: TaskState }): TaskItem[];
  get(id: string): TaskItem | null;
  create(input: string | CreateTaskInput): TaskItem;
  update(id: string, patch: UpdateTaskPatch): TaskItem | null;
  delete(id: string): boolean;
  transition(
    id: string,
    nextState: TaskState,
    meta?: Record<string, unknown>,
  ): Promise<TaskItem>;
}

declare module "cordis" {
  interface Context {
    todo: TodoService;
  }
  interface Events {
    "todo:before-transition"(
      payload: BeforeTransitionPayload,
    ): Promise<void | false | string> | void | false | string;
    "todo:changed"(task: TaskItem): void;
  }
}

export interface TodoListSlotContext {
  readonly tasks: readonly TaskItem[];
  readonly filter: "open" | "done" | "all";
  readonly refresh: () => Promise<void>;
}

export interface TodoItemSlotContext {
  readonly task: TaskItem;
  readonly refresh: () => Promise<void>;
}

/**
 * Input handed to a generic client-side transition interceptor.
 * `meta` is mutable: interceptors may enrich it before the HTTP request leaves
 * the browser, and the server side `todo:before-transition` listeners see it.
 */
export interface TodoTransitionInterceptorInput {
  readonly task: TaskItem;
  readonly nextState: TaskState;
  readonly meta: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export type TodoTransitionInterceptorVerdict = void | false | string;

export type TodoTransitionInterceptor = (
  input: TodoTransitionInterceptorInput,
) => TodoTransitionInterceptorVerdict | Promise<TodoTransitionInterceptorVerdict>;

/**
 * Client half of the generic dual-end transition seam. Components mounted into
 * `todo.transition.guard` register interceptors imperatively; todo-core owns
 * the ordering/verdict handling while the feature logic stays in the plugin.
 */
export interface TodoTransitionGuardSlotContext {
  readonly registerTransitionInterceptor: (
    interceptor: TodoTransitionInterceptor,
  ) => () => void;
}

declare module "@host/client-sdk" {
  interface SlotPropsMap {
    "todo.header.actions": TodoListSlotContext;
    "todo.sidebar.sections": TodoListSlotContext;
    "todo.list.banner": TodoListSlotContext;
    "todo.item.badges": TodoItemSlotContext;
    "todo.item.detail": TodoItemSlotContext;
    "todo.transition.guard": TodoTransitionGuardSlotContext;
  }
}
```

```ts
export default class TodoReviewService extends Service implements ReviewService {
```
```ts
  private readonly db: ScopedDb;
  constructor(ctx: Context) {
    super(ctx, "todoReview");
    this.db = ctx.db;
    this.db.exec(`CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS plg_todo_review__reviews (...)`);
    ctx.http.route("GET", "/reviews", () => ({ reviews: this.list() }));
    ctx.http.route("GET", "/reviews/:taskId", (req) => ({ review: this.get(req.params.taskId) }));
```
```ts
    const events = ctx as unknown as EventBus;
    events.on("todo:before-transition", (payload) => this.beforeTransition(payload as TransitionPayload));
  }

  list(): Review[] { ... ORDER BY updated_at DESC }
  get(taskId): Review | null {...}

  private beforeTransition(payload: TransitionPayload): string | void {
    if (!payload || payload.nextState !== "done") return;
    const taskId = payload.task?.id;
    if (typeof taskId !== "string" || taskId.length === 0) return;
    const summary = extractSummary(payload.meta);
    if (summary === null) return "完成任务前必须填写复盘总结";
    if (summary.length === 0) return "复盘总结不能为空";
    if (summary.length > MAX_SUMMARY_LENGTH) return `复盘总结最多 ${MAX_SUMMARY_LENGTH} 个字符`;
    this.record(taskId, typeof payload.task?.title === "string" ? payload.task.title : "", summary);
  }

  private record(taskId, taskTitle, summary) {
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    this.db.prepare(`INSERT INTO ... VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(task_id) DO UPDATE SET task_title = excluded.task_title, summary = excluded.summary, updated_at = excluded.updated_at`).run(taskId, taskTitle, summary, now, now);
    const review = this.get(taskId);
    if (review) (this.ctx as unknown as EventBus).emit("review:recorded", review);
  }
}
```
